authority: Authored benchmark contract; neither author sample ledger nor chemical mass-balance claim.
invariants: One object occupies one location/carrier at a time; station occupancy cannot overlap unless the scene explicitly supplies multiple nests.
Mixed product has all consumed parent IDs; symbolic portions are debited exactly once and residuals remain traceable.
Aliquot and sister-film IDs are new children, never copies with no inventory cost.
Batch, specimen, region, scan, time point and repeat IDs represent different levels; multiple scans do not increase independent-sample count.
Layer addition, scribing, cured seal, film formation, solution ageing, heating, sectioning and sputtering append irreversible state.
Source-ambiguous formula uses neutral family ID plus parent reagents; never fixes identity by inference.
Returning an item to storage preserves age, damage, phase checkpoint, solvent history and calibration history.
A fresh condition, temperature-independent comparison or destructive assay requires reserved sibling stock if the previous sample is incompatible.
Quarantined failed attempts and invalid acquisition records remain in final manifest.
Compound labelled model salts may enter as traceable reference stock or from an explicitly linked model-crystal route; unreported dissolution/preparation remains a gap.
assembly_dependencies: substrate -> Ti -> Sn-modified layer -> PMMA:PCBM -> perovskite -> PEAI -> HTL -> MoO3 -> ITO -> Au
module adds P1 before layer stack; P2 before electrodes; P3 after Au
encapsulated module child has module, contact, cover and sealant parents
source_specific_exceptions: S24 names perovskite/SnO2@TiO2/FTO; do not force the full device stack onto that profile.
Quartz, sapphire and mesoporous-FTO optical films are separate material lineages.
Fig.4 snapshot films, S30 wet-film videos and device-fabrication films have distinct state histories.
S13 precursor ageing and S31/S32 film ageing are different clocks.
ISOS-L-1 and L-2 are independent condition branches; one module cannot be reset between them.
